name: no-tax-overview
description: Overview of the Norwegian tax system for income year 2026: the tax authority (Skatteetaten), the calendar tax year, residence and the 183 and 270 day tests, the 22% tax on ordinary income, bracket tax (trinnskatt) in five steps, national insurance contributions, the personal allowance and minimum deduction, tax on dividends and share gains (upward adjustment factor 1.72), net wealth tax (1.0% and 1.1% above NOK 1,900,000) and the new wealth tax deferral, corporate tax at 22% (25% for the financial sector), withholding tax on dividends, employer contributions, VAT rates and registration, and the main filing and payment dates. Trigger phrases: Norway tax overview, how does tax work in Norway, Norwegian tax rates 2026, formuesskatt, trinnskatt 2026, skattemelding deadline. Out of scope, see the domain skills: no-income-tax, no-capital-gains, no-corporate-income-tax, no-social-contributions, no-employer-payroll, norway-mva, no-vat-return, no-individual-residence, no-transfer-pricing, no-co
